memory_update.text: DPZ should remain a reference anchor for the restaurant vertical-integration node because its dough manufacturing and food distribution system directly illustrates procurement density as a franchise moat.

FARM is a speculative shadow candidate: it may be a hidden restaurant/foodservice input supplier through coffee, beverage, condiments, and DSD services, but the post-2023 asset-sale business mix must be re-verified.

WEST is an underfollowed B2B coffee and beverage-solutions candidate with plausible foodservice exposure, but margin durability, debt, and customer proof are required before it can move beyond Layer 1.

This pass still needs primary-source verification for foodservice distributors, cold-chain logistics providers, bakery/dough manufacturers, cheese/dairy suppliers, sauce/topping suppliers, packaging vendors, route-density software, and inspection/certification providers.
The key chokepoint is not the restaurant menu item but the combination of recurring ingredient volume, distribution density, service-level reliability, and franchisee procurement economics.

node: Vertically integrated food manufacturing and distribution
summary: Layer 1B expands the vertically integrated food manufacturing and distribution node for restaurants. The clearest reference anchor is Domino's, whose in-house dough manufacturing and food distribution system illustrates the chokepoint: dense restaurant networks can turn ingredient procurement, commissary scale, and service-level reliability into a franchise advantage. The underfollowed lane is more speculative and includes B2B coffee, private-label, direct-store-delivery, and packaged-food suppliers that may sit one or two steps away from restaurant demand but do not screen as restaurant companies. The strongest underfollowed candidates from the provided evidence are Farmer Brothers and Westrock Coffee; TreeHouse Foods is included as a hypothesis because of its acquisition of Farmer Brothers' Northlake facility and non-direct-store-delivery business, but its restaurant-system exposure requires verification.
